paragraphs.text: Grayson Wildemere is a first-year human student at Silverquill College in Strixhaven University. Known for his sharp wit, privileged background, and strategic mind, he is an ambitious figure on campus with one eye always on the future.

Grayson hails from an old and influential family, and he views his education at Strixhaven as a stepping stone to greater power and prestige. In addition to his studies, he is deeply involved in extracurricular ventures, most notably the Future Entrepreneurs of Strixhaven, where he explores business theory and helps launch student-run start-ups. He is equally active in the Strixhaven Star, serving as a gossip columnist whose biting commentary and exposés have both earned him enemies and made him a campus figure of notoriety.

Grayson is observant and calculating, known to gather information on students and faculty alike, waiting for the perfect moment to use it. He's even taught himself lock-picking to gain unauthorized access to restricted spaces, always in search of a new secret. While many peers regard him with caution or suspicion, some have quietly witnessed his acts of generosity, like secretly purchasing books and supplies for less fortunate students, a kindness he tries to keep hidden from public view.

Those who befriend Grayson often find themselves benefiting from his connections and negotiating skills, scoring rare discounts and insider deals. But those who cross him may see their names twisted in scandalous gossip columns, with exaggerated versions of their worst traits spread across campus.
